g.text: {C3 selected optional; not a fourth role}
No Assessment-to-Reviewer connector; Orchestrator constructs RiskReviewRequest.
Risk receives packet, original statements, order_lookup, attachments, evidence_matrix,
full retrieval_result (including conflicts), citation_verification, optional image_observations.
Returned RiskReview is PASS / PASS_WITH_WARNING / REVISE / NEEDS_INFORMATION / ESCALATE.
Raw source receipts reach control independently of generator prose (CS-D01).
Domain must validate source/case/input bindings before receipts become accepted Risk inputs.
Role/tool observations and run metadata reach Domain through D12 -> CS-01 A02 -> AuditPort.
No part here owns a case-write port, ApprovalRecord capability or operations provider port.
Internal evidenceRead is scoped by A; no arbitrary URL/path/token reaches C3 (CS-Q02).
P/R = provided/required contract; Dxx delegation, Axx assembly; request/reply uses same line.
Agent parts include deterministic invocation wrappers; LLM text cannot choose connection authority.
[0..1] means capability may be disabled in a run; C3 remains required selected course work.
CS-D01 receipt forwarding and CS-Q02 artifact-port details require A/C review, not new wire DTOs.
Existing class/method/DTO mapping and original authorship: docs/13. Candidate, not running software.
